zh.runtime.title: 运行时记忆

en.runtime.title: Runtime Memory
en.runtime.description: Compact context carried into every turn.
en.runtime.noMatch: No runtime memory matches the current scope and query.
en.runtime.addDescription: Injected every turn; use Memory Spaces for long-term notes.
en.runtime.placeholder: One concise, standalone fact or preference…
en.runtime.target.memory.description: Project facts and conventions; auto-archived when full
en.runtime.removeWarning: After removal, this content will no longer load with every turn. This action cannot be undone.

en.runtime.result.localCompaction: Local profile compaction complete: no Memory Space write; updated {target} · {count} entries
